column1: # Readable names for address-named symbols (tools/names.py, docs/contributing/names.md). Columns:

column5: evidence
NTSC-U 0x001425C0: Byte per item: its current row in weapon_table, which is its level; levelling up moves it along the rows' +0x46 chain. Identity in a new game.
NTSC-U 0x00142660: s32: bolts; the vendor spends them.
NTSC-U 0x00142668: s32: maximum health (10 on a new game).
NTSC-U 0x00142670: Eight items, most recently chosen first; Triangle's tap cycles the first three.
NTSC-U 0x00142692: Set in challenge mode: a level and area's help measure is 0 then.
NTSC-U 0x00142694: The hero's own XP: a kill adds to it as to the gun's, and it raises his health.
NTSC-U 0x00142698: XP held back: moby_killed pays (bank + 49) / 50 into the gun's XP each kill; 0x3177F8 adds rewards.
NTSC-U 0x0014269C: Bolts that didn't fit in coins, or coins spawned far from the camera or left far from the hero; moby_killed pays out (bank + 49) / 50 with each kill.
NTSC-U 0x001426A0: Short, saved: the armor number worn (the armor WAD entry, 0-4). Inferno Mode sets it to 4 for a while.
NTSC-U 0x001426BA: u8: the challenge-mode bolt multiplier less one, 0 to 19; 0x1426BB counts kills toward the next step (challenge_mult_kill).
NTSC-U 0x001426D8: The armor bought, which armor_worn returns to when Inferno Mode ends; armor_change tints the hero moby (byte +0x7E) by it when it is 1-3.
NTSC-U 0x0014271E: A bit per skin entry 0-7 that is unlocked (skin_unlocked); entries 8-15 are at 0x1427A8.
NTSC-U 0x001427A8: A bit per skin entry 8-15 that is unlocked (skin_unlocked); entries 0-7 are at 0x14271E.
NTSC-U 0x001427AB: Byte, saved: the skin worn as an armor WAD entry (5-13), 0 for none. armor_load and armor_install use it in place of the armor number.
NTSC-U 0x001427F0: Word per item: its rounds, capped at the row's +0x8A by ammo_add and taken by ammo_use.

NTSC-U 0x00142A60: One byte per item, 0x9C of them, kept with the save data: the gun's mods, set by each gun's own code from its level. Bit 5 lock-on, bit 1 shock (0x34BF98), bit 3 acid. All zero in our savestates, none of which holds a gun.
NTSC-U 0x00142CA0: Byte per item: owned. Set by item_give; grind_boots_owned is item 0x0E's byte.
NTSC-U 0x00142CAE: Byte that hero_find_rail requires before it looks for rails; presumably the grind boots. [low confidence]
NTSC-U 0x00142D40: Byte per item, set with item_owned by item_give; probably the menus' new-item mark.
NTSC-U 0x00142DE0: Word per item: XP in 1/32 points, compared against the row's +0x68 (total XP to leave the level) by weapon_level_up and the weapon menu page; moby_killed adds to it.

NTSC-U 0x001439F4: Byte, the camera option: 0 third person, 1 lock-strafe, 2 first person. Set by the options menu (0x49CB48) and the quick-select items 0x24-0x26 (0x41AB20) through hero_camera_set. Picks the row of the camera option tables; when not 0, pad_button_for moves R1 to R2 and L1 to L2 and lets L1 jump.
NTSC-U 0x001439FD: The 16:9 option's byte: when set (or in split screen) the view's vertical half-angle tangent is divided by 4/3.

NTSC-U 0x00143A06: Byte, the QUICK SELECT PAUSE option (text 0x507, options row 5 at 0x2ED870, set by 0x49C368); on in our image. On: holding Triangle pushes game mode 4, sub-state 7, and the world stops; off: the ring is an overlay and the world runs.
NTSC-U 0x00143A10: 3 x 8 words, camera setting x player: the vertical invert option. All 1 in a new game.
NTSC-U 0x00143A70: 3 x 8 words, camera setting x player: the horizontal invert option. 1 for third person and 0 for the other two in a new game; both mean not inverted in their own code.
NTSC-U 0x00143AD0: 3 x 8 words, camera setting x player: the camera speed option, 50 in a new game. The follow camera uses speed / 100, the free-look camera lerp(0.25, 1.25, speed / 64).

NTSC-U 0x00162AF0: The armor WAD's global header from the table of contents: size 0x398, first sector, 56 entries of {mesh sector, count, textures sector, count}, then two {sector, count} pairs for Clank's textures (0x162E78).
NTSC-U 0x001651C8: The gadget WAD's header in memory: {size, sector} and 48 entries of {class, file range, sound bank range}.
NTSC-U 0x0016C6A4: i16 current entry; 0x16C6A6 the current slot. [low confidence]
NTSC-U 0x0016C6C4: Which entry each of the three slots holds.
NTSC-U 0x0016C6D0: Three buffers of 0xC800 bytes.
NTSC-U 0x00191ED0: Where a gun's class is unpacked; must end before 0x1A1EE0.

NTSC-U 0x001A1EE0: GS addresses (x 256 bytes) of the textures loaded outside levels: palettes for the armor, the wrench, texture_slot_load and Clank, one more, then the pixels in the same order from 0x1A1EF4.

NTSC-U 0x001A3170: 52 sound slots of 0x80 bytes: +0 the library's handle, +4 the entry, +8 the sound number, +0xA the class's entry index, +0xC the volume scale, +0x10 the state (7 starting, 1 playing, 4 stopping), +0x14 the pitch, +0x1C the moby, +0x20 the position.
PAL 0x001A4BE0: Base address the hero code uses (667 references). It is 0x20 past the start of the hero's memory region (0x1A4BC0), so code offsets are offsets from that start minus 0x20.
NTSC-U 0x001A4C60: The hero's position, at his feet; 0x1A4CC0, 0.7 u above, is where pickups fly to.
NTSC-U 0x001A4D30: Vector: what the platform's carry moved the hero this frame, after its collision (hero_move_step). camera_hero_copy passes it to the camera as CameraHeroData +0x70.
PAL 0x001A4D98: Frames since the current state began; reset by hero_change_state. Checked in traces of the running game.
NTSC-U 0x001A4DB4: Wall-contact countdown: 6 (7 in a wall jump) while a wall is in reach, counted down each frame.

NTSC-U 0x001A4DDE: i16 countdown; a dive from the surface needs it at 0. hero_timers_update counts it down and on Florana (2) and Marcadia (4) sets it to 10 every frame. In the Aquatos sewers' overlay a level object (update at 0x323B68 there) sets it to 2 every frame while the hero is in its volume and outside its two exception volumes; in a new game's sewers that is everywhere.
NTSC-U 0x001A4DE4: i16: frames before a zip line can be caught; set to 30 when the hero lets go.
NTSC-U 0x001A4DE8: Frames before another fidget may play; set to 120 when one starts.
NTSC-U 0x001A4E10: s32 frames: crate 0x1F7 adds 1800; counts down each frame, beeping at 300, 240, 180, 120, 60 and 1, and clears bolt_multiplier_exp at 0.
NTSC-U 0x001A4E18: While above 0, hero_camera_allowed refuses and mode 0x20 can't start. Set to 2 by the scripted camera, 10 by the fixed camera (mode 0x17), 4 for Clank.
NTSC-U 0x001A4EE0: The ground point the hero last stood on (vec4). The flip looks for ground near its z before going over a drop.
NTSC-U 0x001A4F1C: Written by hero_ground_probe: distance down to the ground, 32 when none was found.
NTSC-U 0x001A4F20: Written by hero_ground_probe: the ground's angle from the horizontal, in radians.
NTSC-U 0x001A4F30: Written by hero_ground_probe: the water surface's height under the hero. Quicksand's is at 0x1A4F34.
NTSC-U 0x001A4F3C: The moby the ground probe found under the hero, 0 for level ground.
NTSC-U 0x001A4F40: Frames the hero has stood on the ground, from the ground probe (0 in the air). Crouching and the early crouch flip need it non-zero.
NTSC-U 0x001A4F4E: i16: frames off the ground, 0 while standing.
NTSC-U 0x001A4FA0: The moby carrying the hero (hero_platform_carry); 0x1A4FA4 bit 0 marks his position pinned in its frame (0x1A4F50), bit 1 his facing (0x1A4F60, while not turning).
PAL 0x001A5040: Start of the per-jump parameters hero_change_state fills (the jump_* fields). Checked in traces of the running game.
NTSC-U 0x001A504C: u8: counts up from 1 once a jump-type state lands; the state ends a couple of frames later. A landed flip can flip again on X, R1 and a stick press.
NTSC-U 0x001A504E: u8: set once a jump-type state is past its push-off and its vertical speed is under 0.001 u a frame.

NTSC-U 0x001A505C: Set per jump state by hero_change_state: the ticks of its push-off, the profile's pushoff_ticks. The jump's transitions wait for it, and its animation rate is set on the tick after.
NTSC-U 0x001A505E: i16: hero_ticks_to_land's answer, worked out each frame past the apex while the animation is early enough; the crouch flip slows from the frame after it reaches 11.
NTSC-U 0x001A5070: The flip's way: the move angle (the stick's) when it started.
NTSC-U 0x001A5074: The yaw the flip turns back to, hero_yaw_back(10) when it started (with its vector at 0x1A5030); spring gain 0.04, damping 0.2, cap 0.11636 rad a frame.
NTSC-U 0x001A5078: Three floats hero_change_state sets per jump: the peak frame, the landing frame (+4) and the landing keyframe (+8); the landing replays the sequence from that keyframe + 2.

NTSC-U 0x001A5084: i32: hero_strafe_side when the flip started (left 0, right 1, forward 2, back 3). A back flip lands with no speed, and an attack from it waits for frame 20 where the other flips wait for 18 (hero_attack_start).

NTSC-U 0x001A5088: The ground speed at the start (0x1A4D54) if over 0.025 u a frame, else 0; it carries on along flip_facing, scaled by the sine of the angle from there to flip_move_angle, and is the speed the flip lands with.

NTSC-U 0x001A508C: The flip's own speed along flip_move_angle: the crouch flip's from 0 to 0.07 by 0.0022222 a frame and back to 0 near the landing; the strafe flip's from 0.083333 to max(0.033333, 0.091667 x stick) by 0.013056.
NTSC-U 0x001A5090: The wall normal found by hero_detect_wall; its yaw is at +0xC. A wall jump copies both to 0x1A50A0 and 0x1A50AC to compare with the next wall.
NTSC-U 0x001A50C4: hero_anim_rate_to_frame's factor in the jump states: 0.5, a keyframe being two frames; 1 in the ledge jump (27).
NTSC-U 0x001A50D0: Set per jump state by hero_change_state: the gravity in u a frame squared that hero_ticks_to_apex and hero_ticks_to_land take.
NTSC-U 0x001A50DD: u8: the flip moves as the strafe flip (started while strafing with the stick past 0.3), else as the crouch flip.

NTSC-U 0x001A50DE: u8: set on entering the standing, run, long, heli and some other jumps; with it, R1 and a stick press in the last 5 frames turn the jump into the flip while it is still on the ground before frame 12.
NTSC-U 0x001A50E0: hero_detect_ledge's result for the hero: +0x00 hang point, +0x10 lip point, +0x24 wall yaw, +0x28 found flag, +0x34 flags (bit 0: room above the lip), +0x38 the object grabbed.
NTSC-U 0x001A51C0: Frames since the rail's spline ran out; at 6 the grind falls, and the grind attack needs it 0 to start.
NTSC-U 0x001A51C4: The grind's speed per frame: the base (0x1A5200, towards 0.2) plus the slope term (0x1A51F4).
NTSC-U 0x001A51D8: The grind's stance offset, added to the rail's yaw for the facing: -pi/2 on getting on, +pi/2 when grind_stance_object lies the other way.
NTSC-U 0x001A51DC: 0 or 1 with grind_stance: the grind plays sequence 44 + this.

NTSC-U 0x001A5228: A moby pointer the grind's entry checks; more than 90 degrees from the stance side, it turns the stance round. What sets it isn't read. [low confidence] [clash: already an identifier in src/ or include/]
NTSC-U 0x001A5248: Frames the hero has been more than 1.07 u above the ground under the rail, 30 frames into a grind; at 6 he falls.

NTSC-U 0x001A527C: hero_find_zipline's found flag; hero_transitions then starts state 118 unless the grind search found a rail. The found point is at 0x1A5250, the spline, segment and position at 0x1A5270-0x1A5278.
NTSC-U 0x001A5280: 0 while riding a zip line; counts frames from the cable's end, and at 6 the hero falls.
NTSC-U 0x001A5284: Speed along the zip line, u per frame: half the velocity along the cable on catching, then +0.0025 per frame up to 0.23333.
NTSC-U 0x001A52A0: Matrix (0x1A52A0), direction (0x1A52D0, the hero's facing) and angles (0x1A52E0, yaw plus the upper-body twist). Guns shoot along it when they have no target.

NTSC-U 0x001A5570: +0x10 dive time (the dive lasts 40), +0x14 bank rate, +0x18 pitch rate, +0x1C saved yaw rate, +0x24 minimum swim timer, +0x2C the surface swim's bob spring rate, +0x30 Cross and +0x32 Square hold counts.
NTSC-U 0x001A57A4: The hero's attack fields up to 0x1A57BE: attack row, step, serial and the chain buffer.
NTSC-U 0x001A57B8: The target the gun in hand aims at this frame (the lock-on target 0x1A6010 or its aim assist's), set by the gun's update and cleared by hero_head_look.
NTSC-U 0x001A57BC: The attack table row of the attack under way: 0-2 the combo, 3 the throw, 4 the jump attack, and 0 or 1 again for the grind attack's two swings.
NTSC-U 0x001A57BE: Set when the attack under way has clanked off a wall or hit a target; a new attack clears it. While set, no clank, hit sound or sparks.
NTSC-U 0x001A57E0: Speed of the hero's animation; it advances rate x 0x1A57E4 (0.5 in the Veldin image) frames a tick. Swimming sets it from the speed.
NTSC-U 0x001A57F8: The current animation's frame, as a float; the ledge and get-hit transitions and the ledge jump's forward speed are timed by it. [low confidence]
NTSC-U 0x001A5810: 9 x 0x40 joint matrices for the item mobys.

NTSC-U 0x001A5A50: Two animation layers (right arm, left arm) holding the gun in hand: +0x08 weight, +0x18 the hold class (1 or 2), +0x34 leaving. hero_item_switch marks both leaving when the new item's hold type differs.

NTSC-U 0x001A5A58: Two animation layers (right arm, left arm) of the arms-only firing animation (row +0x28, +0x2C), started by hero_fire_anim and run by hero_gun_update. 0x1A5A64: 0 while in, 1 or 2 as they fade out.
NTSC-U 0x001A5DC0: 7 x 0x50: the moby at +0x20.
NTSC-U 0x001A5DFA: Set while the thrown wrench is out; the hero can't attack again until it is caught.
NTSC-U 0x001A5E00: i32: frames the item has been in hand, counting up; restarts at 3 as the hand changes.
NTSC-U 0x001A5E04: i32: 2 with held_item in hand, 3 while changing, 0 empty. Square with a gun out ran 3, 0, 3, 3, 2, and the swing started the frame after.
NTSC-U 0x001A5E08: The item in the hero's hand, set by hero_spawn_item_mobys: 9 the wrench, 0 while changing. Verified: 47 with the N60 drawn, then 0 and 9 as Square brought the wrench.
NTSC-U 0x001A5ED0: The back slot's pack moby: the heli-pack (class 0x25F) for back item 2, the thruster-pack for 3. 0x1D66000 in the Veldin image.
NTSC-U 0x001A5ED4: Clank's moby on the hero's back (class 0x259, item 1's class). 0x1D66100 in the Veldin image.
NTSC-U 0x001A5EF4: The back slot's state: 2 once its mobys exist (ready); the back rules only run then.
NTSC-U 0x001A5EF8: The back slot's item when its pack moby was made: the saved one, else 2 (the heli-pack), or 3 when 0x142691 is set.
NTSC-U 0x001A6010: The moby the hero is locked on to, or 0. The camera turns to it, weapons and the reticle (0x3F4700) read it.

NTSC-U 0x001A6014: i16: set to 1 by hero_update while L2 or R2 is held (pad bits 1 and 2), 2 by the first-person and lock-strafe cameras; counts down to 0 when they are let go. Most hero code treats it, or camera mode 1 with fire held, as strafing.
NTSC-U 0x001A6016: Strafing backwards with the stick past 0.15; the walk then plays sequence 20 (walking backwards) at 25 x its speed in u per frame, 0.7 to 2.2.
NTSC-U 0x001A6017: Where the stick points while strafing, relative to the camera: left 0, right 1, forward 2, back 3.
NTSC-U 0x001A6018: The yaw the strafe moves along, the move angle (the stick's); the walk's velocity follows it, and so does a jump's push-off. strafe_heading_vec at 0x1A6000 is the same as a vector.
NTSC-U 0x001A601C: hero_strafe_turn's own yaw rate, kept between frames apart from the walk's (0x1A4D84).

NTSC-U 0x001A602C: Two i16 timers: +0 set to 3 by strafing right, +2 by strafing left. hero_strafe_walk counts both down first; strafing left with +0 running zeroes the speed, strafing right with +2 running scales it by (3 - timer) / 3.
NTSC-U 0x001A6040: The target the lock reticle shows (faded out before a change).
NTSC-U 0x001A6044: 0..1, 0.1 a frame.
NTSC-U 0x001A6048: 45 deg/s.

NTSC-U 0x001A6056: Byte: set by hero_floor_material on material 14, a puddle whose surface it puts 0.2 u above the floor. With the depth under 0.25 the walk makes wading's splashes, but the hero doesn't wade.
NTSC-U 0x001A6100: The hero's free-look camera: +0x00 the eye point, +0x20 fps_cam, +0x190 hero_camera_mode, +0x1AC fps_eye_height.

NTSC-U 0x001A6120: FpsCamVars: matrix rows forward, left, up (+0x00), camera position (+0x30), yaw (+0x40) and its speed, max speeds and rates (+0x48-+0x5C), pitch (+0x60, positive looks down) and its speed, max speed, rate and target factors (+0x68-+0x7C), quick-turn state (+0x80), target (+0x8C) and weight (+0xB0), pitch limits down/up (+0xB4/+0xB8), offset (+0xC0), flags (+0xE0), facing (+0xF0), aim point (+0x110), range 30 (+0x120), offset length (+0x124) and its speed (+0x128).
NTSC-U 0x001A61AC: fps_cam +0x8C: the free-look camera's target.
NTSC-U 0x001A61D0: fps_cam +0xB0: 1 for a target its ray hits, else (cos off - cos 15) / (1 - cos 15).
NTSC-U 0x001A61E0: vec4 in the camera's own axes: (-6, 0, 0) in lock-strafe for Ratchet, so the camera sits 6 u back along the view; 0 in first person.

NTSC-U 0x001A6230: The point the free-look camera aims at (the offsets line up with fps.active at 0x1A6290). Written by fps_cam_find_target (0x411918): the hit of a 30 u line from the camera, or its end.
NTSC-U 0x001A6244: f32: the lock-strafe camera's current distance behind the eye; cut at once by walls, eased back out (0.00556 u/frame^2, at most 0.333 u/frame) to the offset's length.

NTSC-U 0x001A6290: 0 for the follow camera, 1 lock-strafe, 2 first person. Set by hero_camera_update and hero_camera_set: camera_setting when that is 1 or 2 and hero_camera_allowed; 2 in look or targeting once look_ready is set.
NTSC-U 0x001A62AC: f32: the eye's height above the hero along his up vector; springs to 2.0 in lock-strafe, 1.75 in first person (1.0 crouching). Its speed is at +4.
NTSC-U 0x001A62B4: The crosshair's pulse phase.
NTSC-U 0x001A62B8: The crosshair's fade-in count (to 20).
PAL 0x001A71A4: Current hero state.
NTSC-U 0x001A71AC: The hero state's type: 6 for attacks, 15 for the grind states 39-42.

NTSC-U 0x001A71C5: u8: set by the look camera (mode 4) once its blend is half done, cleared by hero_change_state. Lets the look and targeting states snap the hero's facing to the camera's yaw and puts hero_camera_mode at 2.

NTSC-U 0x001A71C9: Set by hero_fire_anim, cleared when the firing animation ends or hero_fire_stop runs. While set: no double jump, and the four guns' own walk turn in hero_walk_turn. Checked in traces of the running game.

NTSC-U 0x001A71CA: Byte: set by hero_floor_material in water (not a puddle, material 14) 0.25-0.85 u deep. The walk (2) runs as wading (117) while it is set: hero_transitions swaps 2 and 117 each frame, and hero_change_state turns an entry to 2 into 117 unless strafing.

NTSC-U 0x001A71CB: Row +0x30 copied by hero_fire_anim: 1 for the guns fired by holding the button. While set the walk keeps its setting-off turn and holds its speed past 45 deg off the stick, and another animation doesn't end firing. Checked in traces of the running game: 0 for the Shock Blaster, 1 for the N60.
NTSC-U 0x001A71CC: The hand item's hold (row +0x18): 0 none (the wrench, whip and gloves), 1 one hand, 2 both hands. Set as its moby spawns (hero_spawn_item_mobys).
NTSC-U 0x001A71CD: Byte: guns refuse to fire while set. hero_change_state clears it on each change and sets it for the ledge states and others.
NTSC-U 0x001A71D0: Set by hero_change_state for states 23 to 27 (the ledge), cleared on each other state change: the hold layers leave and none starts.
NTSC-U 0x001A71D8: The hand item asked for (quick select, quick switch); hero_item_switch brings it out and makes it equipped_gun. 0xCC is none.
NTSC-U 0x001A724C: 32 floats: the hero's yaw at the start of each frame, written by hero_update; the next slot at 0x1A72CC, the count at 0x1A72D0.

NTSC-U 0x001A73EC: The camera mode the hero asks for, copied to the camera's +0x2CC: 4 look, 0x51 targeting, 7 swing and grapple, 0 or 3 otherwise; hero_tick makes it 0x20 when hero_camera_allowed returns 1 or 2.
NTSC-U 0x001A7404: f32, hero +0x2824: how far across pickups are taken; 8.7, 17.0 with the Bolt Grabber V2 (item 7), 2.125 in critter mode. Set every 4 frames by 0x4FAA68.
NTSC-U 0x001A7408: f32, hero +0x2828: how far up from his feet pickups are taken; 3.0, 4.5 with the Bolt Grabber V2, 1.25 in critter mode.
NTSC-U 0x001A7418: The stick magnitude m (0..1) the transitions compare with 0.5, 0.7 and 0.85.
NTSC-U 0x001A7428: Water surface less the floor's height; 0.25-0.85 sets the wading flag at 0x1A71CA.
NTSC-U 0x001A7430: Below 1, idle, walk and get-hit recovery go to the death state (57).
NTSC-U 0x001A7450: Ticks to Clank's next fidget, counted down (timer_tick) only while he could fidget.
NTSC-U 0x001A7454: A wall is close in front, so the gun points up. hero_fire_anim then plays arms only, the Shock Blaster's hit waits 5 frames, the Annihilator fires along the gun.
NTSC-U 0x001A745E: i16, 27 or 15 frames after the unpaused ring opens; once it runs out the pad's gameplay input is blocked (pad +0x1CC = 2) every frame.
NTSC-U 0x001A7460: i16, 20 on a Triangle press; letting go while it runs asks for a quick switch.
NTSC-U 0x001A7462: i16, 20 on a tap; makes the unpaused ring's input delay 27 frames instead of 15.
NTSC-U 0x001A749C: 40 whenever the hero isn't in state 29; counted down there, and the Shock Blaster doesn't fire until it runs out. Checked in traces of the running game.
NTSC-U 0x001A74A0: Byte set by hero_quick_switch_button on a tap, taken by hero_quick_switch.
NTSC-U 0x001A74A8: u8: bolts and XP are shifted left by it; crate 0x1F7 adds 1, cleared when bolt_multiplier_timer ends.
NTSC-U 0x001A7E18: The help messages' slots, 24 bytes each: a halfword counts how often the slot was shown, and when.
NTSC-U 0x001A91E8: s32 per level: frames played while bolt_rate_on, not while the pad has been untouched 900 frames (0x4B5258).
NTSC-U 0x001A9280: s32 per level: bolts collected while bolt_rate_on (bolt_pickup_collect); bolts_drop scales small drops by bolts x 3600 / bolt_rate_frames.
NTSC-U 0x001BBC40: Progress flags, 16 bytes per level (flag + level x 16, bit 0x80): once set, the things they guard stop for good.
NTSC-U 0x001BBE90: 0x400 bytes a level: 4 bits per moby UID, its kill count 0-7 and a flag.
NTSC-U 0x001C5290: s32 deaths for each of 16 areas of each level (0x40 bytes a level), counted by hero_death_done and lowered at checkpoints.

PAL 0x001CD0C0: Pad state for port 1: raw DualShock bytes from +0 (sticks at +4..+7), processed stick floats at +0x108/+0x10C, held buttons at +0x1A0. [clash: already an identifier in src/ or include/]
NTSC-U 0x001D4B60: armor_change keeps the armor number here; the code reads it as a word array, so it may be the start of a larger record. [low confidence]
NTSC-U 0x001D4B64: Where the armor is read: its textures first, then its mesh over them (0x1F28000 on Veldin).
NTSC-U 0x001D4C40: The gun Circle brings out (hero_item_switch); 0x1D4C44 the boots slot, 0x1D4C48 the suit slot and 0x1D4C4C the back, all spawned by hero_spawn_item_mobys.
NTSC-U 0x001D4C48: The suit slot hero_spawn_item_mobys spawns, after the gun (0x1D4C40) and boots (0x1D4C44) slots.
NTSC-U 0x001D4C60: Two rings of eight item words, 0x1D4C60 and 0x1D4C80; quick_select_add fills the first free slot.
